channel.title: Global portal on product recalls
channel.description: List of recalls created in the Global Portal on Product Recalls since 7 days, as of Sun, 18 Oct 2026.

item.title: Papablic Bedside Sleepers with Play Yard Extensions
item.description: This recall involves Papablic bedside sleepers, model PAPA03001AI. These convertible sleepers function as both a bassinet and a play yard and have a gray exterior with an interior printed in a stars-and-moon pattern. The products have "Papablic" stitched in white on the front gray fabric panel. Model "PAPA03001AI" is printed on a label sewn to the interior fabric of the bassinet underneath the mattress pad.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Crystal Glass Cups with Loose Crystal Chips
item.description: This recall affects Crystal Glass Cups containing loose crystal stone chips between two layers of glass. The cups are intended for both decorative use and drinking. Each cup measures approximately 3.5 by 3 inches. The crystal stone chips are sold in various options: amethyst, black obsidian, rose quartz, smoke quartz, fire and clear quartz, moss agate, hematite, black tourmaline, black tourmaline in quartz, charoite, blue apatite, morganite, larimar, red jasper, malachite, garnet, kunzite, fluorite, peridot, aquamarine, watermelon tourmaline, carnelian, lapis lazuli, tigers eye and labradorite.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Blitz and Blitz 777 air rifles
item.description: This recall involves all units of the Hatsan Blitz and Blitz 777 pellet shooting air rifles sold from February 2020 through March 2026. Both the Blitz and Blitz 777 pellet air rifles were sold in .22, .25 and .30 calibers. The pellet air rifles are gas operated and select-fire (semi-auto/full-auto) pre-charged pneumatic (PCP). They are black and feature a synthetic stock, a carbon fiber air tank mounted beneath the barrel and a rotary magazine feed. Serial numbers and manufacturing dates are engraved on the right side of the receiver above the bolt. On the left side of the receiver is the Hatsan logo, featuring a circular mark, with the word "HATSAN" next to a graphic of a bow and arrow. The model name "BLITZ" or "BLITZ 777" is also marked on the left side of the receiver.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Scotch™ Thermal Laminators
item.description: This recall involves the Scotch™ thermal laminator, model number TL1302Z. The laminator is light gray/white with gray accents and the word "Scotch" is printed in gray on the front. The laminating slot is approximately 13 inches wide, and the machine has a carrying handle on the right side of the machine when viewing from the front. The model number TL1302Z is located on the sticker on the bottom of the laminator and can also be found on the product packaging.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Xalirium Adult Portable Bed Rails
item.description: This recall involves Xalirium-branded adult portable bed rails. They have a white frame with black foam rubber grips and a black fabric pouch. The bed rails measure about 17.15 inches high, 4.33 inches wide and 1.99 inches long. "Xalirium" is printed on the label of the product packaging. Only bed rails without vertical bars inside the opening are included in this recall.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: 101 Dalmatians Faux Leather Coin Purses
item.description: This recall involves the Primark 101 Dalmatians Faux Leather Coin Purse, Model No. 2595301. The coin purse is black and has a picture of a dalmatian and “101 Dalmatians” printed on the front. The model number is located on the product tag attached to the zip puller.

item.title: Panasonic Front-Loading Washer-Dryer Units
item.description: This recall involves Panasonic front-loading washer-dryer units, models NA-LX126BL, NA-LX128BL, and NA-LX128BR, manufactured between September 2022 and July 2025. Detergent or fabric softener may leak from the connections of the automatic dispensing system and drip onto electrical wiring. Under certain circumstances, deterioration of the wire insulation may cause a short circuit, resulting in overheating, smoke, or burning damage. In most cases, the units will automatically shut down and become inoperable. In rare cases, the defect may result in smoke and burning damage.

item.title: Avengers Infinity Gauntlet Medals
item.description: This recall involves the Avengers Infinity Gauntlet medal. The medal is gold, with colorful gems on the front and comes in a black package marked "Marvel Avengers" with Marvel Avengers artwork. The medals are part of the Avengers virtual challenge series. To receive the medal, customers must have completed the Infinity Gauntlet virtual challenge on the Conqueror App.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Snow Peak Takibi Fireplace Propane Inserts and Lava Rocks
item.description: This recall involves the Takibi propane inserts and lava rocks, fireplace accessories that allows Snow Peak's Pack & Carry Fireplace L (ST-032) and XL (ST-034) to operate on propane fuel instead of wood or charcoal. The propane insert includes a detachable hose with a gas flow regulator that controls the intensity of the flame with the twist of a knob. The product also includes lava rocks. Model number ST-332-US can be found on the product packaging and in the user manual.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Romorgniz Six-Drawer Dressers
item.description: This recall involves Romorgniz six-drawer dressers. The wooden dressers were sold in white and black, measure about 27.6 inches wide, 15.6 inches long, 43.2 inches tall and weigh 73.3 pounds.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: PACEARTH Swing Seats
item.description: This recall involves PACEARTH U-type swing seats. The swing seats were sold in various colors including green, blue, pink, red and turquoise. The chain is coated in yellow plastic. Metal carabiners or quick links and yellow webbing straps were included with the swing seats to attach the swing to outdoor swing sets or tree branches. The swing seats were sold as a single unit or a pack of two.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Van Rysel GRVL AF Bicycles
item.description: This recall involves adult multi-terrain gravel bicycles Van Rysel GRVL AF Sword Brown CN FR (model number 8911304), Van Rysel GRVL AF Apex Beige CN FR (model number 8911305), Van Rysel GRVL AF Sword Pink CN FR (model number 8911308), and Van Rysel GRVL AF GRX Black (model number 8929130). The recalled models were sold in sizes x-small, small, medium, large and x-large. The bicycles are designed for off-road gravel riding, road cycling, commuting and bikepacking. Each bicycle can be identified by the model name and Van Rysel Product ID located on the barcode sticker on the frame near the bottom bracket. item.description: This recall involves ONTHEWEI-branded baby bath seats. They are sold in gray, pink, blue and mist green and have detachable restraint arms and suction cups on the underside. "Model No: MY002" and "Date of manufacturer: 2026/1/10" are printed on a label on the back of the bath seat.

item.title: Agrish Adult Portable Bed Rails, models 12014, AG-12011 and 12016
item.description: This recall involves Agrish-branded adult portable bed rails, models AG-12011, 12014 and 12016, for use on adult beds. The model numbers are printed in the owner's manual and labeled on the bed rail's metal post. The recalled bed rails have white tubing with rounded gray foam rubber handle grips. Each model has multiple batch numbers and manufacture dates listed on the unit and the instruction manual. Recalled Bed Rails: Model Numbers Size 12014 About 11 inches wide and 39 inches in height AG-12011 12016 About 37 inches wide and 45 inches in height
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Portable Camping Showers with bucket and immersion heater
item.description: This recall involves Portable Camping Showers with a bucket and immersion heater. The shower system consists of a black rechargeable electric shower pump, a black shower head with gold trim, a black hose, a black 5-gallon collapsible bucket, a 1500-watt metal immersion water heater, and mounting and storage accessories. The ZAREI logo appears on the side of the 5-gallon collapsible bucket. "ZAREI" is printed in white under the display of the shower pump. The immersion heater has distinctive heart-shaped openings in its metal housing and a black plastic endcap.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: Electric Balloon Pumps
item.description: The recalled electric balloon pump is a high-pressure pump that has two operation modes, continuous and touch-on. It is made of plastic and comes in pink with a blue handle and features two nozzles. The pump's model number, 406198, is printed on the silver rating label located on the bottom of the product and on the packaging.
item.dcterms:creator: United States

item.title: HotHands® Rechargeable Hand Warmers
item.description: This recall involves Kobayashi's HotHands-branded rechargeable hand warmers. The white with orange hand warmers were sold in packs of two warmers that can be magnetically joined together and include a charging cable. The hand warmers have a USB-C port to charge the built-in lithium-ion batteries in each unit. The adjustable-heat hand warmers have LED indicator lights on the hard plastic shell and come with a silicone lanyard. Model number "H163650" and the batch number are on the hand warmer's underside, and the white HotHands logo is on the top and on the product packaging. Only electric rechargeable hand warmers with the white HotHands logo are included in this recall.
item.dcterms:creator: United States
